title: EmptyConversation
description: Predicate type: a markdownConversation with no substance -- every message has empty content (an abandoned/blank chat stub, e.g. a chat opened but never typed into). project_markdown.py skips conversations matching this type instead of emitting a content-free .md. Deliberately loose (no additionalProperties) so it matches a full markdownConversation by content alone; it is a filter, not a data format.

EmptyConversation.title: EmptyConversation
EmptyConversation.description: An object whose messages array is non-empty but every message's content is the empty string.
